newsitem.title: USA: Williams seeks $28.1 mln rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Williams seeks $28.1 mln rate increase.

text.p: Northwest Pipeline Corp, a unit of Wiliams Cos Inc, said on Friday it filed a rate case application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) seeking a $28.1 million increase in Northwest's jurisdictional revenues.
The application is expected to become effective March 1, 1997.

Northwest Pipeline said it is seeking the increase because of the loss of revenues from the sale of a stake in its South End facilities, a change in transmission depreciation rates, and higher operating costs. The amount of the increase reflects lower borrowing costs, Northwest said.
Northwest Pipeline owns and operates a 4,000 mile natural gas transmission system in seven western states.
